text:
zoe: Proposal: 3 micro-tutorials (3-7min each) + live demo webinar. Focus: developer onboarding + production benchmark story.
mike: Love it. Headline stat should be simple: "~4x cost improvement for chat flows" with link to raw CSV.
anita: I'll write the landing copy and a short 3-email drip. Two CTAs: "Try the refapp" and "See the production numbers".
jared: For the demo include an iframe + tiny CLI snippet so folks can reproduce locally: ```bash
pip install redwood-client
redwood-bench --model rdx-3b --seq 256 --runs 5
```
leah: Routing: form -> HubSpot -> tag by track -> Slack alert in #marketing-webinar-inbound. I'll add a webhook example and an SDR triage doc.
zoe: Action items: 1) anita: email drip + landing copy (due tomorrow noon) 2) jared: iframe + CLI snippet + demo badge mock (due tomorrow) 3) mike: assemble bench CSV and config file (EOD) 4) leah: HubSpot webhook + Slack routing (EOD).
mike: Uploaded CSV: https://storage.redwood.dev/benchmarks/refapp-mini-171830.csv and config: https://storage.redwood.dev/benchmarks/refapp-config-171830.json
anita: I'll draft social posts (X + LinkedIn) and share CTA variants by EOD.
zoe: Great. Also let's recruit 5 community ambassadors to seed threads during week 2. anita, can you own outreach copy?
anita: Yes, will draft a one-paragraph outreach + DM template.
leah: I'll open OPS ticket for demo CORS/rate-limit: OPS-3150.
zoe: Thanks team — I'll compile the launch brief and calendar invite and post here for sign-off. :thumbsup:
